_note: RECORDED from the live server on 2026-11-13: the clickup_get_list and clickup_get_workspace_hierarchy entries of https://mcp.clickup.com/mcp tools/list (read-only probe of the owner's personal ClickUp; see docs/evidence/phase-8-21a-clickup-list-by-name.md). name, description, inputSchema, annotations and outputSchema are verbatim; each entry's _meta (a UI resource hint) is left out. The kernel resolves a list name with clickup_get_list (MCP_TRACKERS.clickup.lookup.list). clickup_get_workspace_hierarchy is the only tool that lists every space and list, but its name maps to 31 characters and a ClickUp proxy name keeps at most 30 (mappedBudget), so a connect drops it and the kernel can never call it: it is recorded to pin why a space name has no lookup.

tools.name: clickup_get_list
tools.description: Get list details by list_id or list_name. Returns id, name, content, space info, and configured statuses. Use to resolve list names to IDs.

list_id.description: ID of the list to retrieve.

list_name.description: List name as displayed in ClickUp. Matching ignores case and surrounding whitespace, preferring an exact match. If several lists share the name, the first match is returned — verify the space in the result. If not found, confirm the name with the user rather than retrying variants.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID (digits only). Only needed when you have multiple workspaces.

status.description: Status name (e.g., "to do", "in progress"). Pass this value as `status` to update_task.

type.description: Status category: "open", "custom", "closed", "done", "unstarted". Use to distinguish "done" (finished, reopenable) from "closed" (archived).

status_group.description: Where the status is defined: "proj_<space id>", "cat_<folder id>" or "subcat_<list id>".

statuses.description: Full set of statuses configured on the list (including any inherited from the parent folder or space). Use this to discover which status values can be assigned via update_task.

tools.name: clickup_get_workspace_hierarchy
tools.description: Get workspace hierarchy (spaces, folders, lists) with pagination and depth control. Use to browse the structure or to find a space, folder, or list whose name is unknown. When the name is known, clickup_get_list and clickup_get_folder resolve it to an id directly; task tools take ids only.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from previous response. Use to fetch next page of spaces

limit.description: Maximum number of spaces to return per page (default: 10, max: 50)

max_depth.description: Maximum depth of hierarchy to return: 0=spaces only, 1=spaces+folders, 2=spaces+folders+lists (default: 2)

space_ids.description: Filter to return only specific spaces by ID.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID (digits only). Only needed when you have multiple workspaces.

hierarchy.description: Workspace hierarchy tree containing paginated spaces

next_cursor.description: Cursor for next page of spaces, or null if no more pages

has_more.description: Whether there are more spaces to fetch

total_spaces.description: Total number of spaces in workspace (after filtering if space_ids provided)
